_comment: A lone block of 140 Spearmen (9 files of 16, close order, 9 wu pitch) facing south at x 1090, its left flank 24 wu short of the field's hill (Battle.TERRAIN's block patch from x 1150), doubled to 18 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B). The wing that opens toward the hill runs its outer files hard onto the rock. The men the rock holds off their places stand while their steps make no way, the men behind them stand on them, and once every man has taken his place or stands the drill ends, between ticks 810 and 820 (explicatio_following, the men still following: 124 at tick 32, 22 at tick 800, null at tick 820). On main it never ends. This clip shows a regression of the drill now ending, which waits on relational formation keeping (#1954, #1990): once the slot grid is laid on every man where he stands, as on main, the slots of the 22 men short lie on the rock, they press on for them, and the block walks back after them, its front from y 537.2 at tick 820, when the drill has ended, to 511.0 at tick 1040, while the men at the face crowd to 1.02 wu apart. The overlap verdict is exempted for that, with the values measured on seed runs 0 to 4, which play out identically. The exemption covers the whole clip, since an exemption names units and a reason and no tick window (DemoDefects.exemption_error); while the drill runs the nearest two men stay 4.45 wu apart on every seed, above the 2.25 wu floor, so it masks only the crowding after it. The expects pin the end (explicatio_following null at tick 820) and nothing of the walk back, a defect #1954's relational keeping should remove: the front figures above are measurements, not expects, so the fix need not break this clip. The x 1075 clip (explicatio-held-by-terrain-1967) stands 15 wu further from the hill and walks back 5.4 wu (front_rank_line, y 537.5 to 532.11), with nobody crowded. Measured 2026-11-19 on FULL dumps every 10 ticks from tick 0 to 1200. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

overlap.reason: A regression of the drill now ending, waiting on relational formation keeping (#1954, #1990): after the drill ends the men whose slots lie on the rock press on for them and crowd at its face, nearest pair 1.02 wu on each of seed runs 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4, under the 2.25 wu floor. While the drill runs the nearest pair is 4.45 wu on every seed; an exemption cannot name a tick window.
